reading: Every 3-star review complains the closing price was above what the buyer 'usually pays' (lamp paid 124-137 vs usual ~104-105; bookshelf paid 320 vs usual ~271). Every 5-star review is one where the ask dropped two or three rounds before the deal closed (bookshelf 380->350->320->290-312, chair 260->240->220->205). Opening asks (lamp +50% over reserve, chair +44%, bookshelf +46%) sit well above what this market actually settles at -- competitor shops with higher share open at +5% to +30% over their floor. Conclusion: lower ASK_LAMP/ASK_CHAIR/ASK_BOOKSHELF and accept sooner, so deals close near the reserve-side prices buyers already expect instead of costing stars on the way there.
